title: 第1198章 无界中流砥柱第1197章 半步道主境
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
只见塔身之上，九层塔门同时打开。
每一层塔门中都喷涌出海量的鸿蒙紫气。
那些鸿蒙紫气化作九条紫金色的神龙，张牙舞爪地朝着十大界主扑去。
这一砸，蕴含着道塔这件纪元至宝的全部力量。
也蕴含着陆尘满腔的怒火。
他的地盘，岂是别人说来就来，说走就走的？
十大界主同时色变。
“陆尘，你不要欺人太甚——”
荒兽之主咆哮着，六颗头颅同时喷出吐息。
“欺人太甚？”
陆尘笑了。
那笑容中满是冷意。
“你们十个打我一个的时候，怎么不说欺人太甚？”
“你们联起手来想杀我的分身，怎么不说欺人太甚？”
“现在说我欺人太甚？”
他的笑容越来越狰狞。
“我就欺你们了——如何！”
轰——
道塔和十大界主的联手防御撞在了一起。
虚空直接炸开了一个直径万丈的黑洞。

黑洞中散发出恐怖的吞噬之力，将周围的一切都往里吸。
十大界主被震得齐齐后退。
修为最弱的杀戮剑主和缥缈仙帝，更是直接狂喷鲜血。
杀戮剑主胸口那道剑痕又裂开了一分，疼得他整张脸都扭曲了。
缥缈仙帝喷出的鲜血中夹杂着点点金色的仙元碎片，那是道基受损的表现。
其他八位界主也不好受。
每一个都被震得气血翻涌，内腑震荡。
“陆尘——此仇本座记下了——”
荒兽之主咆哮着撕开虚空，拖着六颗头颅狼狈地钻了进去。
“今日之辱，来日必百倍奉还——”
永恒圣主的声音从虚空裂缝中传出，带着无尽怨毒。
太初神帝一言不发地离开，但他的眼神已经说明了一切。
死亡至尊是最后一个走的。
他站在虚空裂缝的边缘，回过头深深地看了陆尘一眼。
“陆尘——下次见面，你不会这么走运了。”
陆尘直视着他的眼睛，嘴角的弧度中满是不屑。
“我等着。”
虚空裂缝缓缓闭合。
十大界主的身影彻底消失在了天地之间。
诸天战场重新恢复了平静。

只留下那一个个永久性的空间空洞，证明刚才那场惊天大战确实发生过。
陆尘站在虚空中，看着十大界主消失的方向。
他的眉头微微皱起。
今天这一战，他看似大获全胜，把十大界主打得狼狈逃窜。
content_en:
On top of the tower, the nine-story tower doors opened at the same time.
A massive amount of Hongmeng Purple Qi spurted out from each tower door.
Those Hongmeng purple energy turned into nine purple-gold divine dragons, and rushed towards the ten world masters with their teeth and claws.
This smash contains all the power of the Tao Tower, the most precious treasure of the era.
It also contained Lu Chen's full anger.
Is it his territory that others can come and leave as they please?
The expressions of the ten world masters changed at the same time.
"Lu Chen, don't bully others too much——"
The Lord of Wild Beasts roared, and all six heads exhaled at the same time.
"Too much bullying?"
Lu Chen smiled.
That smile was full of coldness.
"When ten of you hit me, why didn't you say it was too much?"
"You joined forces to kill my clone. Why don't you say that you went too far?"
"Now are you saying that I went too far to deceive others?"
His smile became more and more ferocious.
"I just deceived you - how about that!"
Boom——
The Tao Tower and the joint defense of the ten world masters collided.
A black hole with a diameter of ten thousand feet directly exploded in the void.
The black hole emits terrifying devouring power, sucking in everything around it.
The ten world masters were shocked and all retreated.
The Slaughter Sword Master and Piao Miao Immortal Emperor, who were the weakest in cultivation, spurted out blood.
The sword mark on the killing sword master's chest cracked open again, causing his entire face to twist in pain.
The blood spewed out by Immortal Emperor Piaomiao was mixed with little golden fragments of immortal essence, which was a sign of damage to the Taoist base.
The other eight world masters also felt uncomfortable.
Everyone was shocked to the point where their energy and blood surged, and their internal organs were shaken.
"Lu Chen——I have recorded this grudge——"
The Lord of Wild Beasts roared and tore open the void, dragging six heads and crawling in awkwardly.
"Today's humiliation will be repaid a hundred times in the future -"
The voice of the Eternal Holy Lord came from the cracks in the void, carrying endless malice.
The Emperor Taichu left without saying a word, but his eyes said everything.
Death Prime was the last to go.
He stood on the edge of the crack in the void, turned back and took a deep look at Lu Chen.
"Lu Chen—next time we meet, you won't be so lucky."
Lu Chen looked directly into his eyes, the curve of his mouth full of disdain.
"I'll wait."
The cracks in the void slowly closed.
The figures of the ten world masters completely disappeared between heaven and earth.
Peace has returned to the battlefield in the heavens.
Only the permanent space holes were left, proving that the shocking battle just now indeed happened.
Lu Chen stood in the void and looked at the direction in which the ten world masters disappeared.
His brows furrowed slightly.
In today's battle, he seemed to have won a complete victory, beating the ten world masters into panic and fleeing.
